examples.text: suvaṇṇakaṭāhe patiṭṭhitadivasato sattarasame divase mahābodhissa abhinav'aṅkurā pāturahesuṃ.
candanagandho'ti niccakālam'eva supisitassa abhinavassa catujjātisamāyojitassa haricandanassa gandho kāyato vāyati.
mayūrakoñc'ābhirude, kokila-abhinikūjite, khattiyānaṃ kule bhadde, kiṃ nu sukhataraṃ tato.

7805.meaning2: gone forth from, retired from the world

7806.meaning1: renounces; retires from the world; leaves the household life
7806.meaning2: goes forth from, retires from the world

examples.text: ajj'eva tāt'abhinikkhamissaṃ, bhogehi kiṃ asārehi, nibbinnā me kāmā, vantasamā tālavatthukatā.

7807.meaning1: renouncing; retiring from the world; leaving household life
7807.meaning2: renunciation, retirement from the household life
7807.commentary: (MNt) abhinikkhamanan'ti therasseva mahatā ñātiparivaṭṭena mahatā ca bhogaparivaṭṭena saha ghar'āvāsapariccāgo abhinikkhamanaṃ.

examples.text: vipassissa, mārisā, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa evaṃ abhinikkhamanaṃ ahosi evaṃ pabbajjā evaṃ padhānaṃ evaṃ abhisambodhi evaṃ dhammacakkappavattanaṃ.

7808.meaning1: retired from the world; left the household life; ordained
7808.meaning2: went forth from, retired from the world

examples.text: mam'eva etaṃ na hi tvaṃ paresaṃ, sannāhakāle paridevitena kiṃ, sabbaṃ idaṃ calam'iti pekkhamāno, abhinikkhamiṃ amatapadaṃ jigīsaṃ.

7809.meaning2: having gone forth from, having retired form the world

examples.text: bhavanā abhinikkhamma, addasaṃ lokanāyakaṃ, indīvaraṃ'va jalitaṃ, ādittaṃ'va hut'āsanaṃ.
āmasanā, parāmasanā, omasanā, ummasanā, olaṅghanā, ullaṅghanā, ākaḍḍhanā, patikaḍḍhanā, abhiniggaṇhanā, abhinippīḷanā, gahaṇaṃ, chupanaṃ.

7815.meaning1: firmly grabbing hold (of); seizing tightly; forcing into submission; forcibly restraining

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, aggivessana, dantebhi dantam'ādhāya jivhāya tāluṃ āhacca cetasā cittaṃ abhiniggaṇhato abhinippīḷayato abhisantāpayato kacchehi sedā muccanti.

7816.meaning1: firmly grabs hold (of); seizes tightly; forces into submission; forcibly restrains

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, balavā puriso dubbalataraṃ purisaṃ sīse vā gale vā khandhe vā gahetvā abhiniggaṇheyya abhinippīḷeyya abhisantāpeyya.
tassa mayhaṃ, aggivessana, etadahosi, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ dantebhi dantam'ādhāya, jivhāya tāluṃ āhacca, cetasā cittaṃ abhiniggaṇheyyaṃ abhinippīḷeyyaṃ abhisantāpeyyan'ti.

7817.meaning1: should be tightly seized; should be forced into submission; should be forcibly restrained (by)

examples.text: tena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā dante'bhidantam'ādhāya jivhāya tāluṃ āhacca cetasā cittaṃ abhiniggaṇhitabbaṃ abhinippīḷetabbaṃ abhisantāpetabbaṃ.
abhiyogino ca nipuṇā, bahū pana nimittakovidā, sukhumanayanakusalā manujā, piyadassano'ti abhiniddisanti naṃ.
yadā kho, bhikkhave, kummo kacchapo soṇḍipañcamānaṃ aṅgānaṃ aññataraṃ vā aññataraṃ vā aṅgaṃ na abhininnāmi, atha siṅgālo kummamhā nibbijja pakkāmi, otāraṃ alabhamāno.

7820.grammar: pr, caus of abhi nī √nam, trans (+acc & +dat)

examples.text: yassa kassaci ca abhiññāsacchikaraṇīyassa dhammassa cittaṃ abhininnāmeti abhiññāsacchikiriyāya tatra tatr'eva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane.

7821.grammar: pr, caus of abhi nī √nam, trans (+acc)

examples.text: upasaṅkamitvā kummaṃ kacchapaṃ paccupaṭṭhito ahosi, yadā'yaṃ kummo kacchapo soṇḍipañcamānaṃ aṅgānaṃ aññataraṃ vā aññataraṃ vā aṅgaṃ abhininnāmessati, tatth'eva naṃ gahetvā uddālitvā khādissāmī'ti.
yaññad'eva hi so, bhante, kakkaṭako aḷaṃ abhininnāmeyya taṃ tadeva te kumārakā vā kumārikā vā kaṭṭhena vā kathalena vā sañchindeyyuṃ sambhañjeyyuṃ sampalibhañjeyyuṃ.
so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigat'ūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte pubbenivās'ānussatiñāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmesiṃ.

7823.meaning1: lies down hard; lies down heavily (on)

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu saṅghike vihāre uparivehāsakuṭiyā āhaccapādakaṃ mañcaṃ vā pīṭhaṃ vā abhinisīdeyya vā abhinipajjeyya vā, pācittiyaṃ.
seyyaṃ kappeyyā'ti mañcassa vā pīṭhassa vā pavisantassa vā nikkhamantassa vā upacāre seyyaṃ santharati vā santharāpeti vā, āpatti dukkaṭassa. abhinisīdati vā abhinipajjati vā, āpatti pācittiyassa.

7825.meaning1: lies down next to; lies down near to
7825.commentary: (ANa) abhinisīdatī'ti abhibhavitvā santike vā ek'āsane vā nisīdati. dutiyapade'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: kim'assa sampahārasmiṃ? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhuṃ araññagataṃ vā rukkhamūlagataṃ vā suññāgāragataṃ vā mātugāmo upasaṅkamitvā abhinisīdati abhinipajjati ajjhottharati.
jegucchī hoti uccāraṃ vā passāvaṃ vā abhinisīdituṃ vā abhinipajjituṃ vā.

7829.grammar: prp of pass of abhi ni √pad, pass, intrans (+instr)

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhuṃ araññagataṃ vā rukkhamūlagataṃ vā suññāgāragataṃ vā mātugāmo upasaṅkamitvā abhinisīdati abhinipajjati ajjhottharati. so mātugāmena abhinisīdiyamāno abhinipajjiyamāno ajjhotthariyamāno sikkhaṃ apaccakkhāya dubbalyaṃ anāvikatvā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevati.

7833.meaning2: falling against, rushing on, attacking, engagement, conjunction

7838.meaning1: completely crushing down; squeezing down hard

examples.text: āmasanā, parāmasanā, omasanā, ummasanā, olaṅghanā, ullaṅghanā, ākaḍḍhanā, patikaḍḍhanā, abhiniggaṇhanā, abhinippīḷanā, gahaṇaṃ, chupanaṃ.

7840.meaning1: completely crushing down; squeezing down hard

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, aggivessana, dantebhi dantam'ādhāya jivhāya tāluṃ āhacca cetasā cittaṃ abhiniggaṇhato abhinippīḷayato abhisantāpayato kacchehi sedā muccanti.
tena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā dante'bhidantam'ādhāya jivhāya tāluṃ āhacca cetasā cittaṃ abhiniggaṇhitabbaṃ abhinippīḷetabbaṃ abhisantāpetabbaṃ.

7842.meaning1: completely crushes down; squeezes down hard

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, balavā puriso dubbalataraṃ purisaṃ sīse vā gale vā khandhe vā gahetvā abhiniggaṇheyya abhinippīḷeyya abhisantāpeyya.
tassa mayhaṃ, aggivessana, etadahosi, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ dantebhi dantam'ādhāya, jivhāya tāluṃ āhacca, cetasā cittaṃ abhiniggaṇheyyaṃ abhinippīḷeyyaṃ abhisantāpeyyan'ti.

atha kiñ'carahi tvaṃ, ānanda, tathāgataṃ yāvatatiyakaṃ abhinippīḷesī'ti? sammukhā m'etaṃ, bhante, bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ, yassa kassaci, ānanda, cattāro iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā yānīkatā vatthukatā anuṭṭhitā paricitā susamāraddhā, so ākaṅkhamāno kappaṃ vā tiṭṭheyya kapp'āvasesaṃ vā.

7844.meaning1: is accomplished; is successfully attained; materializes; is produced

examples.text: tassa ce, bhikkhave, kulaputtassa evaṃ uṭṭhahato ghaṭato vāyamato te bhogā abhinipphajjanti.
yassa khv'āhaṃ atthāya cittaṃ paṇidahiṃ so me attho abhinipphanno
yassa hi so, bhikkhave, atthāya usukāro tejanaṃ dvīsu alātesu ātāpeyya paritāpeyya ujuṃ kareyya kammaniyaṃ sv'āssa attho abhinipphanno hoti.

7848.meaning1: produced; came up with; successfully achieved (by)

examples.text: idaṃ me, bhante, cīvaraṃ atirekatikkhattuṃ codanāya atirekachakkhattuṃ ṭhānena abhinipphāditaṃ nissaggiyaṃ. im'āhaṃ saṅghassa nissajjāmī'ti

7849.meaning1: makes (someone) produce (a robe); makes come up with
7849.commentary: (KVa) abhinipphādeyyā'ti evaṃ vacībhedaṃ katvā tikkhattuṃ codayamāno paṭilābhavasena sādheyya.

examples.text: dvattikkhattuṃ codayamāno sārayamāno taṃ cīvaraṃ abhinipphādeyya, icc'etaṃ kusalaṃ, no ce abhinipphādeyya, catukkhattuṃ pañcakkhattuṃ chakkhattu'paramaṃ tuṇhībhūtena uddissa ṭhātabbaṃ
devadatto pothujjanikaṃ iddhiṃ abhinipphādesi.

7851.grammar: imp 2nd pl of abhinibbajjayati, irreg form of abhinibbajjayatha, trans (+acc)
7851.meaning1: you must expel; you must turn out; you must dismiss
7851.commentary: (SNPa) abhinibbajjiyāthā'ti vivajjeyyātha mā bhajeyyātha, mā c'assa abhinibbajjanamatten'eva app'ossukkataṃ āpajjeyyātha

examples.text: saṃsappī ca musāvādī, taṃ viditvā yathātathaṃ, sabbe samaggā hutvāna, abhinibbajjayātha naṃ.

7852.meaning1: having completely avoided; having shunned; having steered clear (of)

examples.text: yam'idaṃ kāyasucaritaṃ, vacīsucaritaṃ, manosucaritaṃ, ime tayo kusale dhamme abhinibbajjetvā yam'idaṃ kāyaduccaritaṃ, vacīduccaritaṃ, manoduccaritaṃ, ime tayo akusale dhamme samādāya vattissanti.

7853.meaning1: produced (by); generated (by); brought into being (by); resulting (from)

examples.text: evam'eva kho, mahārāja, yaṃ taṃ tejaṃ vīriyā nimmathitaṃ padhāna-abhinibbattaṃ, n'āhaṃ tattha kiñci nānākaraṇaṃ vadāmi, yadidaṃ vimuttiyā vimuttin'ti.
taṃ kiṃ maññasi, mahārāja, siyā nu kho tesaṃ aggīnaṃ nānādāruto abhinibbattānaṃ kiñci nānākaraṇaṃ acciyā vā acciṃ, vaṇṇena vā vaṇṇaṃ, ābhāya vā ābhan'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.

7855.meaning2: producing, causing to come into being

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhu, dvinnaṃ kaṭṭhānaṃ saṅghaṭṭā samodhānā usmā jāyati, tejo abhinibbattati, tesaṃ'y'eva dvinnaṃ kaṭṭhānaṃ nānābhāvā vikkhepā yā tajjā usmā sā nirujjhati, sā vūpasammati.

7858.meaning2: produces; causes to come into being

7859.meaning1: generating; causing to come into being; causing to be reborn (in)

examples.text: sabyābajjhaṃ, bhante, attabhāvapaṭilābhaṃ abhinibbattayato apariniṭṭhitabhāvāya akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, kusalā dhammā parihāyanti, abyābajjhaṃ, bhante, attabhāvapaṭilābhaṃ abhinibbattayato pariniṭṭhitabhāvāya akusalā dhammā parihāyanti, kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti.
katamā ca, bhikkhave, jāti? yā tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ tamhi tamhi sattanikāye jāti sañjāti okkanti abhinibbatti khandhānaṃ pātubhāvo āyatanānaṃ paṭilābho, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, jāti.
taṇhā hi naṃ sibbati tassa tass'eva bhavassa abhinibbattiyā.

7861.meaning1: would have come into existence; would have been reborn
7861.meaning2: would have come into existence; would have been reborn

examples.text: viññāṇañ'ca hi, ānanda, mātukucchismiṃ okkamitvā vokkamissatha, api nu kho nāmarūpaṃ itthattāya abhinibbattissathā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.

evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, assutavā puthujjano rūpaññ'eva abhinibbattento abhinibbatteti, vedanaññ'eva abhinibbattento abhinibbatteti, saññaññ'eva abhinibbattento abhinibbatteti, saṅkhāre y'eva abhinibbattento abhinibbatteti, viññāṇaññ'eva abhinibbattento abhinibbatteti.
so evaṃ pabbajito samāno lābhasakkārasilokaṃ abhinibbatteti

evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, assutavā puthujjano rūpaññ'eva abhinibbattento abhinibbatteti, vedanaññ'eva abhinibbattento abhinibbatteti, saññaññ'eva abhinibbattento abhinibbatteti, saṅkhāre y'eva abhinibbattento abhinibbatteti, viññāṇaññ'eva abhinibbattento abhinibbatteti.

7865.meaning2: is disheartened; is disillusioned; is disenchanted

examples.text: evam'etaṃ avekkhantī, rattin'divam'atanditā, tato sakāya paññāya, abhinibbijjha dakkhisaṃ.
sa kho so, bhikkhave, evaṃ ussoḷhī-pannaras'aṅgasamannāgato bhikkhu bhabbo abhinibbidāya, bhabbo sambodhāya, bhabbo anuttarassa yogakkhemassa adhigamāya.

7869.meaning1: (of mental defilement) completely quenched; entirely emancipated; completely cooled

examples.text: etadaññāya ye satā, diṭṭhadhamma-abhinibbutā, upasantā ca te sadā, tiṇṇā loke visattikan'ti.
santo ca bhikkhu abhinibbut'atto, iti'han'ti sīlesu akatthamāno, tam'ariyadhammaṃ kusalā vadanti, yass'ussadā n'atthi kuhiñci loke.

7870.meaning1: self-extinguished; self-quenched; with completely cooled mind

examples.text: santo ca bhikkhu abhinibbut'atto, iti'han'ti sīlesu akatthamāno, tam'ariyadhammaṃ kusalā vadanti, yass'ussadā n'atthi kuhiñci loke.
yamhī na māyā vasatī na māno, yo vītalobho amamo nirāso, panuṇṇakodho abhinibbut'atto, so brāhmaṇo so samaṇo sa bhikkhū'ti.
katamā ca, sāriputta, aṇḍajā yoni? ye kho te, sāriputta, sattā aṇḍakosaṃ abhinibbhijja jāyanti, ayaṃ vuccati, sāriputta, aṇḍajā yoni.

7872.notes: passive in construction, active in context

examples.text: yo nu kho tesaṃ kukkuṭacchāpakānaṃ paṭhamataraṃ pādanakhasikhāya vā mukhatuṇḍakena vā aṇḍakosaṃ padāletvā sotthinā abhinibbhijjeyya, kin'ti sv'āssa vacanīyo, jeṭṭho vā kaniṭṭho vā'ti?

7873.notes: passive in construction, active in context

examples.text: atha kho abhabbā'va te kukkuṭapotakā pādanakhasikhāya vā mukhatuṇḍakena vā aṇḍakosaṃ padāletvā sotthinā abhinibbhijjituṃ. taṃ kissa hetu?
paṭhama-abhinibbhidā ahosi kukkuṭacchāpakass'eva aṇḍakosamhā
ayaṃ vuccati, mahānāma, ariyasāvako sekho pāṭipado apucc'aṇḍatāya samāpanno, bhabbo abhinibbhidāya, bhabbo sambodhāya, bhabbo anuttarassa yogakkhemassa adhigamāya.

7876.meaning1: fact of invitation; fact of being summoned
7876.construction:
abhi + ni + √mant + ana + tā
abhinimantana + tā

examples.text: iti h'idaṃ mārassa ca anālapanatāya brahmuno ca abhinimantanatāya, tasmā imassa veyyākaraṇassa brahmanimantanikaṃ't'eva adhivacanan'ti.

7877.commentary: (MNa) abhinimanteyyāma'pi nan'ti abhiharitvā taṃ nimanteyyāma. tattha duvidho abhihāro vācāya c'eva kāyena ca. tumhākaṃ icchit'icchitakkhaṇe mamaṃ cīvar'ādīhi vadeyyātha yen'attho'ti vadanto hi vācāya abhiharitvā nimanteti nāma. cīvar'ādivekallaṃ sallakkhetvā idaṃ gaṇhathā'ti tāni dento pana kāyena abhiharitvā nimanteti nāma. tadubhayam'pi sandhāya abhinimanteyyāma'pi nan'ti āha.

examples.text: abhivādeyyāma vā, bho kaccāna, paccuṭṭheyyāma vā āsanena vā nimanteyyāma abhinimanteyyāma vā naṃ cīvara-piṇḍapāta-sen'āsana-gilānappaccaya-bhesajjaparikkhārehi dhammikaṃ vā assa rakkh'āvaraṇaguttiṃ saṃvidaheyyāma.

7878.meaning1: stamping out; straightening out; smoothing out; correcting (of)

examples.text: yāni kho pan'assa honti sāṭheyyāni kūṭeyyāni jimheyyāni vaṅkeyyāni, tāni yathābhūtaṃ sārathissa āvikattā hoti. tesam'assa sārathi abhinimmadanāya vāyamati.

seyyathā'pi, aggivessana, hatthidamako mahantaṃ thambhaṃ pathaviyaṃ nikhaṇitvā āraññakassa nāgassa gīvāyaṃ upanibandhati āraññakānañ'c'eva sīlānaṃ abhinimmadanāya āraññakānañ'c'eva sarasaṅkappānaṃ abhinimmadanāya āraññakānañ'c'eva darathakilamathapariḷāhānaṃ abhinimmadanāya
so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigat'ūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte manomayaṃ kāyaṃ abhinimmānāya cittaṃ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti.

7882.meaning1: created; formed; produced; made (by supernormal power)

examples.text: yuttā ca te parama-alaṅ'katā hayā, adhomukhā aghasigamā balī javā, abhinimmitā pañcarathāsatā ca te, anventi taṃ sārathicoditā hayā.
sāmo yadā vane āsiṃ, sakkena abhinimmito, pavane sīhabyagghe ca, mettāyam'upanāmayiṃ.
etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ abhinimminantānaṃ yadidaṃ cūḷapanthako.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, rajako vā cittakārako vā rajanāya vā lākhāya vā haliddiyā vā nīliyā vā mañjiṭṭhāya vā suparimaṭṭhe phalake vā bhittiyā vā dussapaṭṭe vā itthirūpaṃ vā purisarūpaṃ vā abhinimmineyya sabb'aṅgapaccaṅgiṃ.

7886.meaning1: magically produces; creates by psychic power
7886.meaning2: magically produces; creates by psychic power
7886.commentary: (PMa) manomayiddhiñāṇaniddese imamhā kāyā aññaṃ kāyaṃ abhinimminātī'ti-ādīsu iddhimā bhikkhu manomay'iddhiṃ kātu'kāmo ākāsakasiṇ'ārammaṇa-pādakajjhānato vuṭṭhāya attano rūpakāyaṃ tāva āvajjitvā vuttanayen'eva susiro hotū'ti adhiṭṭhāti, susiro hoti. atha tassa abbhantare pathavīkasiṇavasena aññaṃ kāyaṃ āvajjitvā parikammaṃ katvā vuttanayen'eva adhiṭṭhāti, tassa abbhantare añño kāyo hoti. so taṃ mukhato abbūhitvā bahi ṭhapeti.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, udāyi, akkhātā mayā sāvakānaṃ paṭipadā, yathāpaṭipannā me sāvakā imamhā kāyā aññaṃ kāyaṃ abhinimminanti rūpiṃ manomayaṃ sabb'aṅgapaccaṅgiṃ ahīn'indriyaṃ.

7887.meaning1: having created; having formed (by supernormal power)

examples.text: mahābandhanā mokkhaṃ karitvā caturāsītipāṇasahassāni mahāviduggā uddharitvā tejodhātuṃ samāpajjitvā sattatālaṃ vehāsaṃ abbhuggantvā aññaṃ sattatālam'pi acciṃ abhinimminitvā pajjalitvā dhūmāyitvā mahāvane kūṭ'āgārasālāyaṃ paccuṭṭhāsiṃ.

7888.grammar: fem, abstr, act, from abhiniropeti, caus
7888.meaning1: (abhi) fixing down (of the mind); act of directing

examples.text: yo kho, bhikkhave, ariyacittassa anāsavacittassa ariyamaggasamaṅgino ariyamaggaṃ bhāvayato takko vitakko saṅkappo appanā byappanā cetaso abhiniropanā vacīsaṅkhāro, ayaṃ, bhikkhave, sammāsaṅkappo ariyo anāsavo lok'uttaro maggaṅgo.

7893.meaning1: sits down hard; sits heavily; sits forcibly (on)

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu saṅghike vihāre uparivehāsakuṭiyā āhaccapādakaṃ mañcaṃ vā pīṭhaṃ vā abhinisīdeyya vā abhinipajjeyya vā, pācittiyaṃ.
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco assakhaḷuṅko, pehī'ti vutto, viddho samāno codito sārathinā purime ca pāde saṃharitvā pacchime ca pāde saṃharitvā tatth'eva cattāro pāde abhinisīdati.

7894.commentary: (ANa) abhinisīdatī'ti abhibhavitvā santike vā ek'āsane vā nisīdati.

examples.text: kim'assa sampahārasmiṃ? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhuṃ araññagataṃ vā rukkhamūlagataṃ vā suññāgāragataṃ vā mātugāmo upasaṅkamitvā abhinisīdati abhinipajjati ajjhottharati.

7897.commentary: (VINa) abhinisīditun'ti abhinissāya nisīdituṃ, apassayaṃ katvā nisīditun'ti attho.

examples.text: jegucchī hoti uccāraṃ vā passāvaṃ vā abhinisīdituṃ vā abhinipajjituṃ vā.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhuṃ araññagataṃ vā rukkhamūlagataṃ vā suññāgāragataṃ vā mātugāmo upasaṅkamitvā abhinisīdati abhinipajjati ajjhottharati. so mātugāmena abhinisīdiyamāno abhinipajjiyamāno ajjhotthariyamāno sikkhaṃ apaccakkhāya dubbalyaṃ anāvikatvā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevati.
